name: mdx-model-turn-on
purpose: Connect a model from the GUI: paste a provider key, the server makes one live call, the kernel records the observation that flips the model to connected.
mechanism: server-side single live call via the kernel's provider gateway
action_surface: provider, key, model, approval -> observation receipt; nothing arbitrary is runnable through it

key_lifecycle.used_for: a single live provider turn-on call, then held in memory for the process so the model can answer

model_selection.rule: explicit request -> env preference -> a suggested top model the provider lists -> the first model the provider lists; every choice is validated against the provider's live model list, so nothing stale can connect.
model_selection.selected_model_drives_replies: Twin's live replies use the model recorded on the latest accepted observation receipt - the GUI choice takes effect, never a baked default.

connected_rule: Connected is true only when an accepted observation receipt AND a usable credential (in-memory or env) both exist - never a green from an accepted observation alone.
observation_restore: the kernel restores the same observation on boot
